## Ruling recorded — option 2: make the block true and keep it short (skills seat, 2026-09-06T15:3xZ)

Governing text: the maintainer's naming ruling on #7434 (5556352576, `BaseSchema` is the documented name for a component node) and objectui `AGENTS.md`'s own sentence above the fence, 「Every node in the UI tree follows this shape」 — a sentence that is a contract for whoever copies the block.

- **Option 2 is ruled.** Drop `props`, `events` and the `ActionDef` reference; declare `hidden` / `disabled` and `children` as the real interface does (the boolean-or-expression wire and the `SchemaNode` shape, spelled the way `packages/types/src/base.ts` spells them); keep the block abridged with one note naming `packages/types/src/base.ts` as the full list. Every line that stays must type-check as written.
- Four axes: 实际业务需求 — agents copy this block into their first schema, and after PR #8090 a copied `props` or `events` fails at the member, later and quieter than the old bad import did; 项目长远合理性 — an accurate abridged sketch plus a pointer is contract-first without becoming a second copy of the interface; 防 AI 犯错 — option 1 leaves the wrong lines in place with a disclaimer an agent will not read, option 2 removes them; 创业阶段不扩散 — option 3 (all twenty-one members) is a drift generator with no gate to hold it, the class this card family exists to stop.
- **Serial**: same file as PR #8090 (draft at the governed terminal); the flight branches from `main` and proves `git merge-tree` clean against `b9d97f06` before opening its PR. Line-neutral if the file is line-pinned in this repo (measure); rules-only register. Governed (root `AGENTS.md`): draft PR, seat review, `os-zhuang` + `hotlong`, human merge.
- objectui#8065 (the published `skills/objectui` tree carrying the same fenced shape) takes the same ruling for its two fences when it is dispatched — recorded there.
